units.source_text: 在村里第一流的温泉旅馆里当佣人的农村姑娘们，商量好请了假。

en.t: The village girls who worked as maids at the finest hot spring inn in the village arranged it together and took the day off.

units.source_text: 村里的人包括阿泷她们，都聚在乡村二流温泉旅馆里，

en.t: The villagers, including Otaki and the others, all gathered at a second-rate hot spring inn in the countryside,

units.source_text: 把村里第一流温泉旅馆的老板的旧闻当作新闻一般数落起来。

en.t: and began criticizing old stories about the owner of the village's finest hot spring inn as if they were fresh news.
